name: AInsteinBench
intro: AInsteinBench 用 244 道可执行任务评测编码 Agent 在科学计算软件中的端到端开发能力。任务来自 PySCF、Qiskit、Einstein Toolkit、AMReX、OpenMM 和 RDKit 六个代码库，结合真实 Issue/PR 修复与模块消融合成功能任务，并通过历史 Docker 环境、Fail-to-Pass 测试和领域专家审核。
build_method: 真实Issue/PR挖掘、功能消融合成、历史环境重建、专家审核
eval_feature: 科学代码执行、Fail-to-Pass测试、CodeAct Agent
intro_en: AInsteinBench evaluates coding agents on 244 executable scientific-software tasks from PySCF, Qiskit, Einstein Toolkit, AMReX, OpenMM, and RDKit. It combines real issue/PR repair with module-ablation feature synthesis, then reconstructs historical Docker environments and applies fail-to-pass tests plus domain-expert review.
drawio_review_note: Reviewed against arXiv:2512.21373v1 §3.1–§3.5, §4, Appendix A, and ByteDance-Seed/AInsteinBench@d9b1383e86c2ae43dcb3ddbcaf34c21ceb786cca. The historical lane crawls and filters repository PRs, rebuilds the historical environment, verifies fail-to-pass behavior, and derives the new minimal API from the fix patch while retaining only test-used signatures. The synthetic lane selects a module, creates an ablation prompt, builds simulation/parameter/output tests, and verifies the reconstructed environment. Each lane undergoes separate expert audit for test undercoverage, overcoverage, false positives, and false negatives. The lanes merge only at the expert-reviewed release of 244 tasks across six repositories.
